# ChengMing Safety Helmet & Vest

> ChengMing Safety Helmet & Vest (cmvest.cn) is a wholesale safety helmet and reflective vest supplier in Qingdao, China, supplying distributors, wholesalers, importers, contractors and project buyers. Wholesale only, direct from the supplying factory. Three ranges: safety helmets, reflective vests and safety goggles, plus a project kit. Price, minimum order, sample policy and lead time are confirmed at inquiry. Test reports are provided by the supplying factory — confirm at inquiry.

## Products

- [Safety Helmets](https://cmvest.cn/helmets): PE and ABS shells, vented and basic styles, with or without chin strap.
  - [PE Basic Safety Helmet](https://cmvest.cn/helmet-pe-basic)
  - [PE Vented Safety Helmet](https://cmvest.cn/helmet-pe-vented)
  - [PE with Chin Strap Safety Helmet](https://cmvest.cn/helmet-pe-chinstrap)
  - [ABS Basic Safety Helmet](https://cmvest.cn/helmet-abs-basic)
  - [ABS Vented Safety Helmet](https://cmvest.cn/helmet-abs-vented)
  - [ABS with Chin Strap Safety Helmet](https://cmvest.cn/helmet-abs-chinstrap)
- [Reflective Vests](https://cmvest.cn/vests): mesh and polyester, basic, with pockets, and full-coverage reflective stripe styles.
  - [Mesh Basic High-Visibility Vest](https://cmvest.cn/vest-mesh-basic)
  - [Mesh Full-Coverage Reflective Stripe Pattern High-Visibility Vest](https://cmvest.cn/vest-mesh-class2)
  - [Mesh with Pockets High-Visibility Vest](https://cmvest.cn/vest-mesh-pockets)
  - [Polyester Basic High-Visibility Vest](https://cmvest.cn/vest-poly-basic)
  - [Polyester Full-Coverage Reflective Stripe Pattern High-Visibility Vest](https://cmvest.cn/vest-poly-class2)
  - [Polyester with Pockets High-Visibility Vest](https://cmvest.cn/vest-poly-pockets)
- [Safety Goggles](https://cmvest.cn/goggles): add-on range in six styles — clear, tinted, anti-fog, over-glasses, splash and welding.
  - [Clear Safety Glasses](https://cmvest.cn/goggle-clear-glasses)
  - [Tinted Safety Glasses](https://cmvest.cn/goggle-tinted-glasses)
  - [Anti-Fog Safety Goggles](https://cmvest.cn/goggle-antifog)
  - [Over-Glasses Safety Glasses](https://cmvest.cn/goggle-overspec)
  - [Splash Safety Glasses](https://cmvest.cn/goggle-splash)
  - [Welding Safety Glasses](https://cmvest.cn/goggle-welding)
- [Safety Helmet and Vest Kit for Hot Weather](https://cmvest.cn/kit): project kit combining helmet and vest.
- [All Categories](https://cmvest.cn/categories)

## How ordering works

- [Contact Us](https://cmvest.cn/contact): send the product, material and quantity; the supplier replies by email or WhatsApp.
- Steps: send your inquiry, confirm the sample, production, inspection and shipping. Timeline is confirmed at inquiry.
- The inquiry form asks for model or reference photo, application / worksite, target market, colour and quantity per colour, reflective layout, closure and pockets, sizes and quantities, logo and packaging needs, sample needs, destination port and trade terms.

## Who we supply

- Construction, logistics & warehousing, manufacturing & assembly, road work & utilities.
